An <c:ffff00>action<c> that uses a <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> of the <c:ffff00>{{head}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{right_arm}}<c> or
<c:ffff00>{{left_arm}}<c>, or the <c:ffff00>Drive<c> during <c:ffff00>{{medachange}}<c>.
It belongs to one of the 6 <c:ffff00>skills<c>, or is <c:ffff00>Special<c>.

<c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> times and effects vary with the
<c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> of the <c:ffff00>{{acting_part}}<c> and the <c:ffff00>legs<c>, and the <c:ffff00>skill<c>
<c:ffff00>level<c> of the <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c>.
